记 $D：\ x^2+y^2\leq a^2$，有

$$
\text{原式}=\iint_D dxdy\int_{\frac{x^2+y^2}{a}}^{\sqrt{2a^2-x^2-y^2}} zdz
$$

$$
=\frac{1}{2}\iint_D[2a^2-x^2-y^2-\frac{1}{a^2}(x^2+y^2)^2]dxdy
$$

$$

$$
=\frac{7}{12}\pi a^4
$$
